articles.title: Getting started with the Nivesh Sahayak App
articles.summary: Start the free Nivesh Sahayak App in a browser or install it: add your business, try the sample data, learn the menu, and know where your data is kept.

articles.title: How to install the Nivesh Sahayak App
articles.summary: Install the free Nivesh Sahayak App on Windows, Mac or Android from Chrome or Edge, add it to an iPhone home screen, and fix a missing Install button.

articles.title: First-run setup of the installed App
articles.summary: The three steps of the installed Nivesh Sahayak App setup: type of business, business details with GSTIN fill, and the features switched on for you.

articles.title: Additional features: switch screens on or off
articles.summary: Switch Nivesh Sahayak App features on or off per business: stock, manufacturing, accounts, GST and industry tools. Off only hides; no data is deleted.

articles.title: The dashboard: your business at a glance
articles.summary: What every tile on the Nivesh Sahayak App dashboard means: sales today and this month, to receive, to pay, cash in hand, bank and UPI, oldest dues.

articles.title: Make any document inside the App
articles.summary: Open the invoice, quotation, receipt and other makers inside the Nivesh Sahayak App with + New document, Open and Convert, and come back with Back.

articles.title: Search everything and keyboard shortcuts
articles.summary: Use Ctrl K to search customers, bills, items and screens in the Nivesh Sahayak App, and keyboard shortcuts N, R, P, E, B and 1 to 9 to work faster.

articles.title: The Sales screen: bills, dues and conversions
articles.summary: Use the Sales screen of the Nivesh Sahayak App: search bills, filter Due or Paid, record a payment against a bill, and convert quotations to invoices.

articles.title: Record money received against bills
articles.summary: Record a customer payment in the Nivesh Sahayak App: tick the bills it settles, handle part payments, advances, TDS cut by the customer and cheques.

articles.title: Record money paid to suppliers
articles.summary: Record a payment to a supplier in the Nivesh Sahayak App: tick the purchase bills it pays, deduct TDS, choose cash, UPI or bank, and print the payment voucher.

articles.title: Enter a purchase bill or a purchase return
articles.summary: Enter a supplier bill in the Nivesh Sahayak App: supplier GSTIN and state, items with HSN and GST, paid now or on credit, bill photo, and purchase returns.

articles.title: Record expenses
articles.summary: Record everyday expenses in the Nivesh Sahayak App: expense type, paid by or on credit, GST included and input tax credit, and how they reach profit and loss.

articles.title: Enter opening balances when you start
articles.summary: Start the Nivesh Sahayak App mid-year: enter what customers owed, what you owed suppliers, cash in hand and bank balance on your start date.

articles.title: Repeating bills for monthly customers
articles.summary: Set an invoice to repeat every month in Nivesh Sahayak and make the due copies from the App's Repeating bills screen with one tap. Nothing is made without you.

articles.title: Dues, ageing and WhatsApp reminders
articles.summary: See who owes you in the Nivesh Sahayak App, split by 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days, with credit limits, due dates and a ready WhatsApp reminder.

articles.title: Party ledger, statement and balance confirmation
articles.summary: Open any customer or supplier ledger in the Nivesh Sahayak App: Dr/Cr running balance, bill-wise view, balance confirmation letter, PDF, Excel, WhatsApp.

articles.title: Group reports
articles.summary: Use party groups in the Nivesh Sahayak App: group summary with opening, debit, credit and closing, dues by group with ageing, and top customers.

articles.title: Cash book, bank book and day book
articles.summary: See every cash and bank entry with a running balance in the Nivesh Sahayak App, record cash deposited or withdrawn, and print or export the cash book.

articles.title: Cheques received and given
articles.summary: Record cheques in the Nivesh Sahayak App, track post-dated and uncleared cheques, mark them cleared or bounced, and see bills become due again after a bounce.

articles.title: How stock works in the App
articles.summary: How the Nivesh Sahayak App keeps stock from bills: godown stock, stock transfers, batches near expiry, serial or IMEI search, and the stock site.

articles.title: Production entries and bill of materials
articles.summary: Make a bill of materials, record production that uses raw material and adds finished goods at cost, with multi-level BOM, versions and by-products.

articles.title: Job work and the ITC-04 return
articles.summary: Track goods sent to job workers in the Nivesh Sahayak App, the one and three year limits, goods received back with charges, and the ITC-04 working.

articles.title: Journal entries
articles.summary: Make a journal entry in the Nivesh Sahayak App when no bill or payment fits: debit and credit lines, accounts and parties, with worked examples.

articles.title: Capital, drawings and loans
articles.summary: Record money the owner puts in or takes out, loans taken and repaid, and loans given, in the Nivesh Sahayak App, with interest and the cash limit.

articles.title: Staff, salary and loans
articles.summary: Put salary slips, PF, ESI, professional tax and TDS, staff advances and loan EMIs into your books with the Nivesh Sahayak App, and see what is still to pay.

articles.title: Fixed assets and depreciation
articles.summary: Add machines, computers, furniture and vehicles to the Nivesh Sahayak fixed assets register; see Schedule II and income-tax depreciation; post it to the books.

articles.title: Trial balance: styles and how to read it
articles.summary: Read the Nivesh Sahayak trial balance: closing or detailed style, group-wise, account-wise or ledger-wise, with stock, and what to do if it does not agree.

articles.title: Final accounts: profit and loss and balance sheet
articles.summary: Make the trading and profit and loss account and balance sheet in the Nivesh Sahayak App, in T format or Schedule III, with previous-year figures and stock value.

articles.title: Manufacturing account
articles.summary: Read the Nivesh Sahayak manufacturing account: raw material used, factory expenses, work in progress, by-products and cost of goods made, with an example.

articles.title: Partnership firm and LLP accounts
articles.summary: Set partners, profit shares, interest on capital and salary in Nivesh Sahayak and read the appropriation account and partners' capital accounts.

articles.title: Income and expenditure, receipts and payments (trusts and schools)
articles.summary: For trusts, societies, NGOs and schools: income and expenditure account, receipts and payments account and capital fund in the Nivesh Sahayak App.

articles.title: Year end: check, close and start the next year
articles.card: Year end and closing a year
articles.summary: Close a financial year in the Nivesh Sahayak App: year-end summary, checks before closing, read-only closed years, and how numbers and balances continue.

articles.title: Reports to Excel for you and your accountant
articles.summary: Download Excel reports from the Nivesh Sahayak App: sales register, purchase register, dues, stock summary, party statements, items, edit history, all in one.

articles.title: GST work from your App data
articles.summary: How the Nivesh Sahayak App data feeds GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B matching, CMP-08, e-invoice and e-way bill tools, and what you file yourself on the GST portal.

articles.title: Where your data is kept, and how to keep it safe
articles.summary: Your Nivesh Sahayak data stays in your own browser: the one data home shared by all tools, backups, one auto save on a computer, and moving to a new device.

articles.title: Check an IFSC code inside the App
articles.summary: Check an IFSC code before you put bank details on a bill or save a party: bank, branch, address, MICR code, and the new code when a bank has merged.

articles.title: Find or check a PIN code inside the App
articles.summary: Check a 6-digit PIN code or find the PIN code of a place inside the Nivesh Sahayak App: post offices, district and state, for addresses on bills and e-way bills.

articles.title: Work out the distance between two places inside the App
articles.summary: Work out the distance between two towns inside the Nivesh Sahayak App: road kilometres, driving time, straight line and fuel cost, for e-way bills and freight.
